event.title: RAHP materiality: Trust Ceremony held-transition authority and effect boundaries
event.proposition: At Trust Tasks Specification PR #53, assess normative verdict rules 2, 3 and 6: a consequential transition held for referral or further evidence must not interpret an approval/evidence item for a different exchange or party, stale authority, a non-allow verdict or partial execution as permission for a further effect. Assess rule 4 unknown evidence and rule 5 hold lifetime as contextual boundaries; multi-party enactment is informative, not global atomicity. Source-level controls are strengthened; implementation and runtime assurance are not established. Historic Toolkit #85 (superseded by #89) and #467/#493/#556/#600 cover earlier revisions, not this proposition. Related #690/#691/#826/#837 retain their narrower obligations. Registry #77 comment 7164185351 records falsifiers and nonduplication. No independent reviewer acceptance or RAHP determination inferred.
